title: 学习现代 Kotlin
author: Beau Carnes
content:
We just published a comprehensive, free Kotlin course on the freeCodeCamp.org YouTube channel.

Whether you're targeting Android development, scalable backend services, or cross-platform applications, this course takes you from writing your first line of code to mastering asynchronous programming and reactive streams.

Here are the things covered in this course:

  • Fundamentals & Setup
    Installing IntelliJ IDEA, understanding the JVM, type inference, primitive types, control flow (when, loops), and Kotlin’s built-in null safety.

  • Functions & Collections
    Default arguments, vararg, lambda functions, arrays, collections (List, Set, Map), binary search, and error handling.

  • Modern OOP
    Primary/secondary constructors, init blocks, data classes, sealed classes, companion objects, singletons, delegation, and extension functions.

  • Deep-Dive Generics
    Variance (in/out), upper bounds, the where clause, and working around JVM type erasure using reified type parameters.

  • Coroutines
    Non-blocking asynchronous programming using launch, async, runBlocking, structured concurrency, timeouts, cancellations, and withContext.

  • Kotlin Flows & Reactive Streams
    Cold streams, intermediate and terminal operators (launchIn, asLiveData), exception transparency, retry logic, and lifecycle handling.

The course is completely free and available now on the freeCodeCamp.org YouTube channel (10-hour watch).

mainPoints.explanation: 该教程弥补了基础语法与结构化并发等高级生产级概念之间的鸿沟。
重点强调 Kotlin 的优势：空安全、数据类和扩展函数。
深入探讨了协程和 Flows，这对于现代非阻塞应用开发至关重要。
